proof_0529.moves: Schemes have a terminal object and all pullbacks, so finite limits follow from the standard reduction of finite limits to terminal object plus pullbacks; the proof is a single application of that reduction.

proof_0530.moves: Rewrite the first marginal of a kernel as the pushforward (map) along Prod.fst, then the zero-or-Markov property transfers through map by the existing instance.

proof_0531.moves: SL(n,R) sits inside the finite matrix space, which is discrete when R is, so discreteness is inherited through the subtype embedding; here the actual argument is hidden behind an auto-generated private proof term.

proof_0532.moves: Both sides of the intersection identity unfold to the same term by definition; the proof is definitional unfolding closed by reflexivity (packaged as simp's of_eq_true/eq_self residue).

proof_0533.moves: Pull a well-order back along an injection: build the IsWellOrder structure by transporting trichotomy through injectivity of f (the relation being r composed with f on both arguments) and inheriting well-foundedness of the pulled-back relation.

proof_0534.moves: Int32 is a thin wrapper over the bit-vector representation, so converting to a bit vector and back is definitionally the identity; the proof is rfl.

proof_0535.moves: From a <= b, ExistsAddOfLE supplies c with b = a + c; destruct that existential, show 0 <= c from a <= a + c using the left-reflecting order hypothesis, and repackage as an existential conjunction.

proof_0536.moves: The Int16 numeral literal is defined through the same bit-vector construction as the right-hand side, so both sides are definitionally equal; the proof is rfl.

proof_0537.moves: Unfold the evaluation of the successor code: it reads the head of the input list and returns the singleton list containing head+1, wrapped in Part.some; the whole thing computes definitionally.

proof_0538.moves: Unfold IsLoopAt and IsNonloopAt into their incidence conditions, then rearrange the resulting propositional formula by pushing the negation through the conjunction and eliminating a double negation classically.

proof_0539.moves: FreeMonoid is definitionally the list type and toList is the identity equivalence, so multiplying by a generator on the left is definitionally list cons; the proof is rfl.

proof_0540.moves: Case split on the option: for none both sides are false, for some the attached element carries the same value so the predicate agrees; each branch closes by computation.

proof_0541.moves: This is the reassociated form of the naturality square for the associator against an identity tensor: take the base naturality identity and post-compose both sides with an arbitrary morphism, reassociating the composites.

proof_0542.moves: Transport the lower-set condition to the order dual: a set is a lower set exactly when its preimage under toDual is an upper set, so the proof is one direction of that characterization.

proof_0543.moves: Internal recursion helper: by structural induction on the node list, every node's rank is bounded by the running foldr-max of the ranks, using that each element is below the max at its step.

proof_0544.moves: Adding a nonpositive element does not increase the sum, so b + c <= b; chain that with the hypothesis a <= b + c by transitivity of the order.

proof_0545.moves: Pure forwarder: the cocommutativity identity is literally a field of the IsCocomm class, so the root-level statement is discharged by that field.

proof_0546.moves: The opposite of a set is defined as the preimage of membership under unop, so membership of op a in it unfolds definitionally to membership of a; the proof is Iff.rfl.

proof_0547.moves: Build the SubgroupClass instance for Subgroup by supplying its three closure fields: multiplication closure from the underlying subsemigroup, one from the submonoid, and inverse from the subgroup itself.

proof_0548.moves: Identify the image of a fiber under the canonical inclusion with the preimage of the singleton, using the map/image characterization of fibers, then flip the equation.

proof_0549.moves: Reassociated form of the comonad coassociativity law in a bicategory: take the comul_assoc 2-cell identity and post-compose it with an arbitrary 2-morphism, then reassociate the resulting composites.

proof_0550.moves: Case split on the option: none gives the empty list and the initial value, some gives a one-element fold; both branches compute definitionally.

proof_0551.moves: Casting a morphism along two reflexivity proofs is the identity by definition; the proof is rfl.

proof_0552.moves: Weaken the predecessor-limit hypothesis to a pre-limit and apply the pre-limit version of the strict inequality with the subtraction of one.
